title: 创造大陆
description: 欢迎来到创造大陆！在这里，你是建筑师也是破坏者——右键搭建方块，建造你的梦想世界；左键拆除重构，自由改写地形地貌。无尽沙盒模拟器，创意与破坏一触即发，快来打造独一无二的奇迹大陆吧！Welcome to the Land of Creation! Here, you are both the architect and the destroyer—right-click to place blocks and build your dream world; left-click to demolish and reshape, freely altering the terrain. An endless sandbox simulator where creativity and destruction are just a click away. Come and craft your own unique miraculous land(English)!
